scripts.heroku-postbuild: if [ "$PROJECT_TARGET" = "api" ]; then pnpm --filter=api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter=api exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm run build --filter=api; else pnpm run build --filter=web; fi
scripts.start: if [ "$PROJECT_TARGET" = "api" ]; then node apps/api/dist/src/main.js; else npm --prefix apps/web run start; fi
